Usage: glacier <command> [options]

Hardware & Configuration Commands:
  devices                              Enumerate detected GPUs, VRAM, and safe driver engines
  config  [options]                    View or set persistent hardware & engine preferences

Model Execution Commands:
  inspect <model.gguf>                 Inspect model architecture, metadata & tensors
  bench   <model.gguf> [options]       Run speed & comparative benchmark
  run     <model.gguf> [prompt]        Interactive streaming chat or single prompt
  serve   <model.gguf> [options]       Start Ollama & OpenAI compatible HTTP server

Global Hardware & Engine Options (bench, run, serve):
  --device <id|name>                   Target GPU/CPU (e.g. nvidia-rtx-4060, amd-890m, cpu, 0)
  --engine <baremetal|directml|cpu|auto> Execution engine (default: auto safe selection)
  --kv-precision <auto|fp16|fp8|fp32>  KV-cache precision (default: auto adaptive)
  --ctx, -c <len>                      Maximum context sequence length (default: 2048)
  --split <spec>                       Heterogeneous multi-GPU pipeline split (e.g. 'auto', 'nvidia-rtx-4060:14,amd-890m:14')

Subcommand Help:
  glacier <command> --help             Detailed help, options, and examples for any command
  glacier help <command>               Alternative syntax for subcommand help
  Example: glacier run --help
  Example: glacier bench --help
  Example: glacier serve --help
